root_cause.summary: The chapter prose, scene evidence, and structured state were not consistently treated as one immutable audited artifact across generation, repair, final gating, StoryProject writeback, and legacy recovery.
confirmed_causes: StoryProject canonicalization could create a new integrity report that lost blocking findings already proven against the pre-canonicalized text.
Scene recovery accepted partially structured payloads and could silently filter malformed event or delta items.
Legacy snapshots did not seed all authoritative character, relationship, roster, location, inventory, and counter state before validating new scene deltas.
Scene field deltas were not fully adapted to the authoritative ledger contract, so stale before-values and identity drift could evade the unified decision.
Completed events, open actions, current location, and present characters were not reconstructed with sufficiently distinct lifecycle semantics for the next scene.
Run Records could omit nested pipeline integrity attempts or lose the source model-call identity for individual scene drafts.
The final StoryProject persistence path did not always prove that the bytes written were the same bytes accepted by every preceding blocking gate.
Recovery context selection did not require a failed or rejected run from the active chapter, so a committed or cross-chapter run could contaminate repair.
Pytest mode=0o700 temporary directories and unguarded test-only directory renames were nondeterministic under Windows Python 3.12 managed ACL and file-scanner behavior.

modules.final_artifact_integrity: Carries blocking findings only across a cryptographically and textually proven safe canonicalization, then binds the accepted hash to writeback.
modules.sequential_scene_pipeline: Requires structured JSON for live scenes, regenerates from the first incomplete recovered scene, and carries lifecycle-aware scene state.
modules.authoritative_state: Seeds legacy state, adapts scene deltas, validates identity, relationships, rosters, inventory, locations, counters, prose declarations, and event references, then persists state_after.
modules.run_record: Merges ordered integrity attempts, records distinct repair attempts, stage hashes, source call IDs, and authoritative validation evidence.
modules.chapter_workset: Projects only blueprint-selected authoritative entities and bounded recent evidence into model context, so input size follows chapter complexity instead of book length.
modules.recovery_context: Exposes recovery evidence only for an uncommitted failed or rejected run whose chapter index matches the active chapter.

new_or_extended_regressions: chapter prose counter agreement and 7-to-2 rollback
5/6/12 roster arithmetic and stable member identity
wife/cousin relationship drift and stale cooperation-boundary before-value
cross-chapter event replay without false positives from bookkeeping beats
StoryProject canonicalization preserving prior blocking findings
Run Record earliest-stage and source-call traceability
same-chapter failed-run recovery selection and cross-chapter exclusion
Windows pytest temporary-directory and directory-rename repeatability

residual_risks: No paid or external-model first-ten-chapter literary experiment was run during verification; provider availability and partial responses remain external variables.
Incident-derived deterministic fixtures preserve the reported failure shapes but are not all bound to retained original blind-run prose hashes.
Direct external Python callers of build_recovery_context must now pass the active chapter_index keyword; all repository callers have been migrated.
Deterministic near-duplicate thresholds may need future calibration for genres with deliberate long refrains.
Legacy projects are seeded into the authority ledger, but ambiguous historical prose cannot be upgraded into facts without explicit structured evidence.
A ten-chapter generation should still be run incrementally with committed checkpoints so a provider failure does not discard earlier accepted chapters.

readiness.recommended_mode: incremental chapters with StoryProject writeback, strict quality policy, review gate, and checkpointed reruns
readiness.guarantee_boundary: Program-level acceptance is proven; external provider uptime, latency, and model response completeness are not guaranteed.
